sources.title: Company Overview | QCT – Quanta Cloud Technology
sources.note: Identifies QCT as Quanta Cloud Technology and Quanta Computer Inc. as its parent.

sources.title: How AI servers are transforming Taiwan’s electronics manufacturing giants
sources.locator: Sections “Quanta Computer’s AI server focus” and “Market share and financial impact”
sources.note: Describes Quanta as the world's second-largest server assembly contractor and reports approximately 17% of a market, without specifying a denominator matching the claimed global top 50 data centers. It does not state that QCT exceeds 50% share among those data centers.

sources.title: The Taiwanese ‘Big Six’ Soaring with Nvidia
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning “In a report on the AI supply chain in March”
sources.note: Attributes to Morgan Stanley a 15% Quanta share of global GPU-server shipments in 2023. This is a distinct product/shipment denominator, not the claimed share among the world's top 50 data centers.
